entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait for the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi. I need to return an item.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your full name and order number?

Thank you, Alex. I'm pulling that up now... I see the VeloBand GPS Tracker, delivered on January 9th. To make sure I'm on the right page, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?
It's fine. I just changed my mind.
Okay, I understand. So you're finding you just don't use it as much as you thought you would?
Exactly. It was an impulse buy.

That can certainly happen. I've reviewed your order details, and per our policy for wearable electronics like the VeloBand, there is a strict 10-day return window for preference-based returns. This is due to the device activation linking the hardware to a user account. Since your band was delivered 18 days ago, we're unfortunately outside that window for a refund.
Of course. So I'm just stuck with a hundred-dollar paperweight.

Not at all. While a direct return isn't an option, we do have the official VeloFit Resale Marketplace. It's a very popular platform for our community to buy and sell gently used gear. Since the device is in perfect condition, you should have no trouble finding a buyer there.
Great. So I get to do all the work to sell something you won't take back. Fantastic.

I want to make that process as smooth as possible for you. I see here that you're a VIP member with us, Alex. As a thank you for your loyalty, I can waive the marketplace listing fee for you. I'm also adding a $25 VeloFit credit to your account right now for any future purchase you might make.
Fine. The resale thing, whatever. Send me the details.
Absolutely. I've just sent an email to the address on file. It has a direct link to create your free listing and a confirmation of that $25 credit. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good rest of your day.
